meta.captures: ledger mpat (paper/claims.py), files carrying Zjm: 185 support-matched captures, 10 cells, 38 (cell, prompt) groups
meta.g_ratio: Table 1 statistic: held-out mean (phi.g)^2 over test Zjm rows / over test Zs rows; edge, whitening, scaling fitted on training rows (positive_control_heldout); 'row' = Table 1 split, 'donor' = common donor partition, joint rows scored only if both donors held out

definitions.patch-A arm: single-site arm with A forced from donors and B recomputed; identified as the arm with larger sd(a) among the rows used (as _fit_edge)
definitions.sd_ratio_joint: sd(b | patch-A arm, training S rows) / sd(b | support-matched joint Zjm, training J rows)
definitions.sd_ratio_joint_all: same, all rows of the capture (reviewer's recomputation)
definitions.edge_r2: R^2 of OLS b ~ a on patch-A arm training rows (the fit giving m, c)
definitions.resid_ratio_joint: sd(b - m a - c | patch-A arm, training) / sd(b | joint, training)
definitions.sd_ratio_armB: sd(b | patch-A arm) / sd(b | patch-B arm), training rows (edge_strength.py's edge strength)

meta.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of the 38 (cell, prompt) groups with replacement, percentile 95% CI, seed 0; p_capture_level treats captures as independent and is descriptive only
meta.escape_subsets: escape_gt10: g ratio > 10 (Table 1 count, 171 row / 173 donor); beats_null: g ratio > the capture's Euclidean random-direction p95 (HeldoutBeatsNull, 180 row)

verification.note: every per-capture g ratio equals positive_control_heldout.json (rtol 1e-9); cell medians/counts equal prospective/paper2/claims.json predictM.* values
